name: typescript
description: TypeScript on Node.js: strict types, narrowing over casts, schemas at trust boundaries, async error handling, module layout; tests with the runner the ADR chose (no mocks of the code under test).
decides: The stack ADR chooses TypeScript (Node.js) as an implementation language.

package-manager.description: The package manager the ADR chose; sets HARNESS_BUILD_CMD (a type check, fast enough for pre-commit) and HARNESS_TEST_CMD.

test-runner.description: The test runner the ADR chose; sets HARNESS_TEST_PATHS and installs its testing skill.

options.description: Vitest (vi.* APIs, happy-dom or jsdom for components).
Strict typing in code: @ts-ignore and @ts-nocheck are refused (use @ts-expect-error with a reason), and `any` outside tests gets a warning.
